name: Foreman MCP Server
description: Enables interaction with Foreman instances to manage systems through the Model Context Protocol. It provides access to Foreman resources and tools, such as security update reports, directly within AI-powered environments like VSCode and Claude Desktop.

rawRecord.description: Enables interaction with Foreman instances to manage systems through the Model Context Protocol. It provides access to Foreman resources and tools, such as security update reports, directly within AI-powered environments like VSCode and Claude Desktop.

HOST.description: The host address to bind the server to.

PORT.description: The port number to bind the server to.

LOG_LEVEL.description: Logging level. Options include debug, info, warning, error, critical.

TRANSPORT.description: The transport protocol to use (stdio or streamable-http).

FOREMAN_URL.description: URL of the Foreman instance. Defaults to https://$hostname if not provided.

NO_VERIFY_SSL.description: Set to 'true' to disable SSL certificate verification.

FOREMAN_CA_BUNDLE.description: Path to a custom CA certificate bundle (e.g., /path/to/ca-bundle.pem).
